entries.title: Nine Sols

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC Steam release is the best fidelity/capture route for Nine Sols, while macOS and the later PlayStation, Xbox, and Switch releases have no sourced exclusive content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Nine Sols on Steam and play the Windows PC build as the primary route. Use console or macOS versions only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original release; no remake/remaster distinction applies.
